Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but Joshua stayed among the people that night.
He took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.

wikipediaActualRead.title: Bethel
wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 記事のBook of Joshua節はJoshua 7:2・8:9と16:1を参照し、ベテルがアイの西側/近くに位置すると説明する。Genesisや後代の宗教史はこのプロフィールの常時表示欄に含めない。
wikipediaActualRead.actualPageExcerptJa: Book of Joshua section explicitly cites Joshua 7:2, 8:9; says Bethel near/west of Ai and mentions territory at 16:1.

geographyAssessmentJa: 本文と地理文献が古代ベテルの町候補を示すため、既存候補点は「ベテル（古代遺跡比定）」の候補として保持可能。ただしプロフィール座標は未確認で、候補を現代ベイティン中心と同一視しない。
